draft_en.subject: PoE switches to power Symway IP phones - under your label from small lots
draft_en.body:
Hello Symway team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 24 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches that power Symway IP phones in your installations, under your label from small lots, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed with VLAN and QoS for voice, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $87.4 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 24 x Gigabit PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP, L2+ managed - STC-424DGGPM-280W - $145.7. Web GUI with the Symway logo; EAC stays on your side.

One question: which port count do your PBX projects use most - 8 for small offices, or 24?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
